broadInvalidationExceptions.rationale: After sign-in and active-organization selection, the authenticated route context must be rebuilt before redirect; this is the sole whole-router bootstrap exception.

classificationDefinitions.server_draft: Editable local draft initialized from server-owned input; later server refreshes intentionally do not overwrite in-progress edits unless the row policy says otherwise.
classificationDefinitions.server_snapshot: Local server-derived snapshot advanced from mutation responses. The row policy names how it is refreshed and any remaining remount or reconciliation dependency.
classificationDefinitions.synchronized_prop_copy: Local copy of an input with an explicit synchronization or delay policy.
classificationDefinitions.client_persistence: Client-owned state initialized from browser persistence or another client-only preference source.
classificationDefinitions.local_runtime: Local runtime/controller state caught by the conservative syntax heuristic; it is not treated as a server-state authority.

limitations: This executable inventory covers production TypeScript and TSX files under src/components and src/routes; it excludes tests, stories, contexts, workers, and external packages.

The state-mirror inventory is a conservative syntax heuristic over non-literal useState initializers. Classification prevents silent new candidates but does not prove semantic completeness or correct synchronization behavior.

The query-key check rejects direct array literals assigned to queryKey and inventories all queryKey property assignments. It does not prove that every factory has ideal domain semantics or that every server read uses TanStack Query.
The invalidation check detects zero-argument .invalidate() calls in scope. The login auth-bootstrap row is the only approved whole-router exception.
